title: People falling off the cliff
content: Now I’m not sure if this directly w mall world but I had this dream a while back when I was having frequent lucid mall world forrest dreams it was weird there was like millions of ppl I’m talking lines and lines lined up in this big forest (rlly beautiful scenery) to the left was straight cliff, everyone kept moving forward in a line towards to this root that was hanging off above a second cliff so u had to jump up to it and pull urself up onto the second cliff wo falling down so many ppl were missing it and falling down idk where but they fell so I was a bit worried to try and I’m not a super athletic person by all means but when it came my turn I easily got up wo hesitation my mom also has mall world dreams she’s told me in detail about the bathrooms water parks all the stores everything and I told her about this dream a bit after it happened and she had the exact same one I didn’t mention the ppl falling and she was like yep and so many ppl were falling now I don’t know what this means I jus thought maybe someone might resonate?
